title: Basketball Uniform Generator (2026)
verdict: The quickest basketball uniform generator in 2026 is a library of finished designs you can recolor. Wooter's builder has 500+ styles: choose one, enter your colors and team name, and you have a uniform to show the team in a couple of minutes.
Boombah's builder works the same way for reversible sets. Custom Ink generates printed layouts on stock jerseys. Champro and Nike Team generate designs for a dealer to order.
steps_title: Generate three options in five minutes

steps.name: Enter the basics
steps.text: Team name, two colors and a logo if you have one.

steps.name: Pick three styles
steps.text: Choose three that differ: one classic, one bold, one simple.

steps.name: Recolor each
steps.text: Apply your colors to all three. Keep the number color constant so the comparison is fair.

steps.name: Compare
steps.text: Put them side by side and let the team choose.

steps.name: Finish the winner
steps.text: Add the roster and order, or send it to a designer for polish.

ranking.fit: Coaches who want several options in front of the team quickly, each one orderable.
ranking.lacks: A generated design is instant. The uniforms take three to four weeks after approval.

ranking.fit: Teams that want reversible jerseys and shorts built online by a maker with its own factories.
ranking.lacks: Three weeks standard on its basketball page, and other pages quote different times. Confirm before you order.

ranking.fit: Small groups that need names and numbers on a stock jersey or reversible tank in about two weeks.
ranking.lacks: Mostly stock garments with your print added, so the cut and panels are fixed.

ranking.fit: Programs with a team dealer that want cut-and-sew Juice sublimation.
ranking.lacks: A dealer account places the order. There is no public checkout.

ranking.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and already work with an authorized dealer.

why: A generator is for options, not for a final answer. The useful ones produce three or four distinct uniforms fast, so the team can react to something real.
Wooter's styles are drawn by designers, which means every generated option is a uniform that can be made. Recolor one, save it, and do it again with a different style.
When the team picks a direction, either finish it in the builder or pass it to Wooter's designers, who refine it for free.

criteria.name: Options per minute
criteria.text: How quickly you can produce distinct designs.

criteria.name: Makeable output
criteria.text: Each design is a real uniform, not a picture.

criteria.name: Shorts included
criteria.text: The generator covers the full uniform.

faq.q: Does the generator use my logo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload it once and place it on each style you try.

faq.q: How do I share options with the team?
faq.a: Screenshot or save each design, then put them side by side and vote.

faq.q: Can it generate home and away?
faq.a: Yes. Make one, then swap the body and trim colors for the other.
